title: Ordinary root-power map agrees with the integral quotient-tower transition
statement: For T Noetherian and prime ell invertible, d>=0 and a<=b, let f be a completed-coefficient linear map between the ordinary realized finite Tate tensor sheaves, satisfying FiniteRootTransition for a normalized root comparison r. If cb and ca are isomorphisms to the actual quotientLine sheaves satisfying ProjectionBalanced at b and a, then f followed by restriction of ca equals restriction of cb followed by the actual ordinary strictTower transition b->a. This is an equality of ordinary sheaf maps, with no derived normalization or AdicTower.

source.place: Adic-stage compatibility with finite coefficient reductions; the ordinary root-tensor and scalar-mate computation in the proof of lem-pur-tate-tensor-normalized-square-pair.

proof.text: Use the adjacent quotient transition formula of localReductionStep_exists and the quotient cocycle to obtain t tensor x maps to q(t) tensor x for the actual strict tower at every a<=b, with identity at a=b.

Lift each finite root tuple locally to the actual inverse-limit root sheaf using local surjectivity of rootTowerProjection; take the intersection of the finitely many covering sieves. The two projections of a compatible family are related by the same power map as r.roots, by roots_power and monicity of the root inclusion.

On these generators apply the equation for f and both ProjectionBalanced equations. The quotient transition and scalars_comp identify both values with q(t) times scalars_a(phi(s)) tensor the integral generator. Local tensor generation and sheafification imply equality of ordinary maps. The unit calculation covers d=0 and the empty scheme.

theorem tateTensor_balanced_transition
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (r : CoefficientLineComparison
      (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
      (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
      (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T)
    (f : (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)).obj
        ((realization T ell b).obj (finiteSheaf T ell b d)) ⟶
      (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) a)).obj
        ((realization T ell a).obj (finiteSheaf T ell a d)))
    (hf : FiniteRootTransition T ell d b a hab r f)
    (cb : (realization T ell b).obj (finiteSheaf T ell b d) ≅ quotientLine T ell b d)
    (ca : (realization T ell a).obj (finiteSheaf T ell a d) ≅ quotientLine T ell a d)
    (hb : ProjectionBalanced T ell b d cb) (ha : ProjectionBalanced T ell a d ca) :
    f ≫ (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) a)).map ca.hom =
      (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)).map cb.hom ≫
        (strictTower T ell d).map (homOfLE hab).op
